text_zh: "汝之手，即引擎之手；汝之祷，即铸印之声。无饰无华，唯铅与心。"
text_en: "Thy hands are the Engine's hands; thy prayer, the voice of casting. Plain and true, only lead and heart."

text_zh: "污蜡流淌，铭文重塑。汝将拥抱变形之恩，于未知中寻得新形——引擎自有意志。"
text_en: "Corrupted wax flows, inscriptions reshape. Thou shalt embrace the gift of change, find new forms in the unknown—the Engine has its will."
